newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTARUUKKI TO UP POLISH UNIT'S CAPACITY.
newsitem.headline: RAUTARUUKKI TO UP POLISH UNIT'S CAPACITY.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said in a statement on Friday its Polish subsidiary Rautaruukki Polska Sp.zo.o would increase its production of steel roofings and related components.
The existing premises would be enlarged by 1,800 square metres of new production facilities, it said but did not state the value of the planned investment.
"The extension to the plant and the increase in production are expected to reinforce Rautaruukki Polska's position in Poland," Rautaruukki said.
"The company has grown to a significant producer of steel roofings in Poland where steel has become a very popular material for roofings," it said.
